eyebrow: ServiceNow DevOps, Testing & Deployment · Chapter One
subtitle: Lesson 1 · Application Lifecycle Management

code:
Release N  ->  Release N+1  ->  Release N+2
   |                |                |
supported        supported        current
   |                |
eventually        eventually
end of support     end of support
caption: Every customer's instances eventually move onto each new release in turn.

steps.label: ServiceNow
steps.sub: performs the technical work of moving an instance onto a new release

steps.label: The customer
steps.sub: plans and validates that move — it's not automatic in the background

steps.label: End of support
steps.sub: older releases eventually lose vendor support, pressuring every customer forward

code:
A script written years ago:            The same script, after a release:
calls an older, now-flagged API    ->  that API is removed or disabled
works fine for years                   script fails at the next upgrade
caption: Deprecated code keeps working right up until the release that finally removes it.

steps.label: Upgraded early
steps.sub: ServiceNow applies the new release to this sub-production instance first

steps.label: Custom work tested
steps.sub: scoped apps, customizations, and integrations are validated there

steps.label: Then production
steps.sub: the live instance is upgraded only after sub-production checks out
